# Flaky tests

Every test observed failing without a code change goes here, with where it
flakes: **local**, **CI**, or **both**. A flake nobody wrote down gets
rediscovered, re-debugged, and eventually retried away; this file is the shared
record so the next agent knows a red run may not be their change.

Add a row the first time you see it, even if you cannot yet explain it. Delete
the row when the fix lands — the entry describes current behavior, not history.

The four `Live …` rows are tagged `@flaky-live` and grep-inverted out of the CI
application profile by
[`playwright.config.ts`](../packages/extension/playwright.config.ts). They
flaked on CI too, which is why they are quarantined; `local` is now the only
place they can be observed. The stable Live start and control journeys stay in
CI.

Columns: **Lane** is the `docs/testing.md` lane (contract, offscreen
integration, host integration, host browser, integration browser, passkey
vault, passkey vault e2e, companion workerd, companion browser, e2e) or the
linked design-system story lane.
**Flakes** is `local`, `CI`, or `both`. **Symptom** is what the failure looks
like — the assertion, timeout, or error. **Notes** is the suspected cause or
the open question.
